correctness.rationale: Complete 16-vertex independent-set enumeration checks 80 maximal tetrahedra and the 16-facet orbit. All 128 core triangles have degree two; sixteen spherical vertex links and dual connectedness prove closed manifold. Explicit 9-step signed dual walk has orientation monodromy -1. Integer Smith factors of core d2,d3 are 1^64 and 1^63*2, while full d2,d3 give 1^65 and 1^79. Relative signed boundary is the 16-cycle incidence of rank15 with all unit factors. A primitive full top nullvector has coefficients magnitude 1 on 64 core and 2 on 16 belt tetrahedra, proving the index-two map via the LES. These are independently recomputed by embedded verify.py, not merely reported as numerical outputs.
